d: David Herdeg and Jim Parker are assigned a project to make an invisible radar. However, during the mission, an unusual incident occurs, transporting the two of them into the future.

Kim Dokja, an ordinary office worker in his 20s, seems to be the only reader of an obscure apocalyptic web novel. The day he finishes the final chapter, the story comes to life — and its omnipotent protagonist Yu Junghyeok appears before him.

Ten years after a meteor collides into Earth causing a worldwide flood, a lonely rancher named Liam lives a quiet, private life on his farm away from others. One day while on a hunt, Liam finds Olivia, a troubled young lady, running for her life on the outskirts of his fields.

Thrown into the high-stakes world of corporate espionage, Morgan (Jeremy Northam), a disenchanted accountant turned spy, teams up with a mysterious colleague (Lucy Liu) on a mission to protect themselves from their ruthless boss.
